# Tatoeba Chinese–English sentence data

These compressed files come from Tatoeba's official per-language exports:

- `cmn-eng_links.tsv.bz2`: Mandarin Chinese–English translation links;
- `cmn_sentences_detailed.tsv.bz2`: Mandarin Chinese sentences and authors;
- `eng_sentences_detailed.tsv.bz2`: English sentences and authors.

Source directory:

<https://downloads.tatoeba.org/exports/per_language/cmn/>

The snapshot used here was published on 2026-08-01. Tatoeba sentence text is
distributed under Creative Commons Attribution 2.0 France unless a sentence is
explicitly marked otherwise. The generated website links every example back to
both source sentence pages and keeps the supplied author usernames.

<https://tatoeba.org/terms_of_use>
